title: Roving Tabindex State Machine in a Tablist
description: Watch tabindex='0' and focus() migrate across tabs on ArrowRight while Tab exits the widget in a single stop.

steps.label: 1. Tab Enters Widget at Active Item
steps.description: Pressing Tab lands on Tab 1 (the sole item with tabindex='0'). Tabs 2 and 3 have tabindex='-1' so Tab skips them.

steps.label: 2. ArrowRight Shifts Roving Pointer
steps.description: Keydown ArrowRight sets Tab 1 to tabindex='-1', Tab 2 to tabindex='0', and calls tab2.focus().

steps.label: 3. Next Tab Exits Widget Cleanly
steps.description: Pressing Tab again leaves the entire tablist immediately and focuses the active tabpanel content.
steps.codeHighlight: // Tab exits composite widget in 1 keystroke
